title: tc-button
description: A button: primary, secondary, ghost or destructive, in three sizes, with a loading state.

variant.description: primary: dark and filled · secondary: white with an outline (Clean: a hairline shadow) · ghost: text only · destructive: red, for deleting

size.description: Height and padding: sm, md or lg (Standard 28 · 32 · 40 px, Clean 24 · 28 · 32 px)

label.description: The button's text (and its accessible name)

hideLabel.description: Icon only: the label isn't shown, but stays the button's name

loading.description: Shows a shimmer over the label, blocks clicks and adds "loading" to the accessible name

disabled.description: Dims the button and disables the native button inside it, so it can't be focused or clicked

type.description: The inner native button's type: "button" does nothing in a form, "submit" submits it, "reset" resets it

name.description: Submitted with the form when this is its submit button

value.description: Submitted as `name`'s value when this button submits its form
